svg.aria-label: The nocap approval card in a terminal, with a red border marking it high risk. Header: approval needed. Claude wants to use Bash. Reason: force-pushes and can overwrite history on the remote. The command shown is git push --force origin main. The choices are y to approve, a to always allow this, and n to deny.
